## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Fit SES and seasonal naïve to Beer

```{r}
fits <- aus_production |>
  model(
    ses = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N")),
    snaive = SNAIVE(Beer)
  )
```

## 2. Residual plots

```{r}
fits |> select(ses) |> gg_tsresiduals()
fits |> select(snaive) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

## 3. Portmanteau

```{r}
augment(fits) |> features(.innov, ljung_box, lag = 8)
```

## 4. Write-up

Which model has residuals closer to white noise? Why?
